summary: The same Aula sitting on several dates is a suspended-and-resumed sitting, not a source contradiction: those events now carry `seduta_pluri_giorno: true` plus `data_apertura` and keep their resoconto link, and `anomalia: true` is left to the one real contradiction (same date, different sitting numbers). Supersedes the inverse guard added by ars-sicilia-iter-seduta-data-inversa.
reason: That guard fired on 4 budget laws out of 4, across two legislatures - L.R. 1/2019 (sitting 98, 31 Jan -> 15 Feb), L.R. 9/2020 (187, 28 Apr -> 2 May), L.R. 28/2024 (142, 5 -> 7 Nov), L.R. 1/2025 (147, 18 -> 28 Dec) - and suppressed the link on «Approvato dall'Assemblea», the one event a journalist wants to cite. In all four the sitting number is right and the record exists, filed under the opening day: the Assembly opens a sitting, suspends it and resumes it until the budget passes, and the resoconti archive indexes it at the opening date. The original guard's own text anticipated this («una seduta sospesa e ripresa in un altro giorno darebbe la stessa coppia di eventi») but treated it as undecidable. It is not the same case as the twin guard, and the justification for dropping the link does not carry over: there one date holds two different numbers and at least one link would be wrong, here the number is single and resocontoSchedaURL is built from the number, so the link cannot point at the wrong day. Every other Aula event is already linked on the declared number alone, with no verification - suppressing it only here demanded of these events a proof asked of no other.
validated_outcome: `ddl iter 17 476|17 733|18 809|18 832`: no `anomalia`, `seduta_pluri_giorno: true` on the events of sittings 98/187/142/147, `data_apertura` on the resumption event only (not on the opening one, where it would repeat the event date), and /bd/resoconti/scheda links on all of them. `ddl iter 17 199`, the genuine same-date/different-number case, still marks its two events and still omits the link - the twin guard is untouched. `ddl iter 18 6030` keeps its 6 resoconto links unchanged. TestSedutePluriGiorno rebuilt on the real ddl 733 event list (committee sitting 187 of 20 Apr and the «Esitato per Aula» row on a committee sitting stay out of the comparison; the same date in the source's two forms is not a false positive); TestAnomaliaRestaSuStessaDataSeduteDiverse pins the guard that must not have been switched off. go build, go vet, gofmt, go test ./... green.
